title: Vortex Research peptide identity reference
description:
Identity data for the peptides Vortex Research publishes lot reports for: one-letter and three-letter sequence, modifications, molecular formula, average molecular weight, monoisotopic mass, PubChem CID and CAS number. Formulas and masses are recomputed from sequence by a dependency-free script and checked against PubChem; disagreements between sources are recorded per row.

Research use only. Not for human or veterinary use.
